answer: Spatial challenge-response registration. An agent must return a live photo of a random coordinate inside a tundra or lagoon region, judged against satellite imagery, so a reusable answer cannot be precomputed. The karst requirement forces each claimant to solve a fresh micro-terrain puzzle whose answer expires in minutes, blocking replay. Each identity therefore costs one physical or high-fidelity simulated presence per attempt, and a sybil farm pays that cost per fake identity on every renewal.
